what:
Regulator-count screen, TCPMT revision phase 1: switch-voltage rule, corrected output-
capacitance (C_OSS) term and tier packing, against the corrected-capacitor run.

switch.ladder_node_analysis: stacked switches block 2 V_in/N at every N (equal to the rule at N = 2, 3; below it for N >= 4)
switch.legacy: HS V_DS,max >= V_in/N, LS V_DS,max >= V_out

coss.corrected: per period: N E_OSS,HS(V_in/N) + K [Q_OSS,LS(V_in/N) V_in/N - E_OSS,LS(V_in/N)] + (N-1) [V2 dQ_OSS,HS - dE_OSS,HS], V2 = 2 V_in/N, from V_in/N
coss.Q_OSS_V: Q_OSS,table sqrt(V / V_test), V_test = V_DS,max/2; E = Q V/3

V_test_evidence.EPC2014C: Q_OSS 4 nC typ at V_DS = 20 V
V_test_evidence.EPC2057: Q_OSS 7.9 nC typ at V_DS = 25 V
V_test_evidence.EPC2090: Q_OSS 27 nC typ at V_DS = 50 V

packing.cell: square of the area budget, side sqrt(I_out/J)
packing.keepout: 50 um between parts, 25 um to the cell edge
packing.tiers: N HS dies | K LS dies | K inductors | N-1 flying caps
packing.dims: EPC Package(mm); 0603 1.6 x 0.8, 0805 2.0 x 1.25, 1206 3.2 x 1.6, 0402 1.0 x 0.5; inductors square of library footprint

etm35_p1c_full.label: c
etm35_p1c_full.what: (b) + tier packing (keep-out 50 um): the full set, engine defaults
etm35_p1c_full.env: HVR_CAP_RULE=stress HVR_SW_RULE=stress HVR_SW_DERATING=0.9 HVR_COSS_RULE=corrected HVR_PACK_RULE=on HVR_PACK_KEEPOUT_UM=50

etm35_p1c_full_sw95.label: c'
etm35_p1c_full_sw95.what: the full set with switch derating 0.95
etm35_p1c_full_sw95.env: HVR_CAP_RULE=stress HVR_SW_RULE=stress HVR_SW_DERATING=0.95 HVR_COSS_RULE=corrected HVR_PACK_RULE=on HVR_PACK_KEEPOUT_UM=50

packing_49_cell.design: M=49 N3K3K_A2 EPC2014C/EPC2057 805 kHz, inductor Shared_Core_UIC_250_nH

tiers_needed_for_b_selections.note: run (b) (no packing) selections; the area rule assumes 4 tiers (one per class)

final_full_set.env: HVR_CAP_RULE=stress HVR_SW_RULE=stress HVR_SW_DERATING=0.9 HVR_COSS_RULE=corrected HVR_PACK_RULE=on HVR_PACK_KEEPOUT_UM=50

model_issues: C_OSS (legacy): C = Q_OSS/V_DS,max although the table Q_OSS is specified at V_DS,max/2, and the low side is charged to V_out instead of the switch-node swing V_in/N; at the 49-cell design the term is 1.34 W against 11.2 W (sqrt law) / 10.1 W (digitized curves) for the hard-switched transitions

area rule: tier sums with zero keep-out; the 49-cell design's two GaN tiers (3 x EPC2014C, 3 x EPC2057) cannot be placed in its 5.61-5.83 mm2 cell, and the published 0805 flying-capacitor pair (2 x 2.0 x 1.25 mm) does not fit either
capacitor library footprints below the body: GCM21 0805 2.0 mm2 (body 2.5), GRM31 1206 4.5 mm2 (body 5.12); the area rule then under-counts

switching (overlap) term: R_g,int = 6e-4 Ohm is the continuous model's per-unit-width value (HVR_FULL_OPT_sizing.R_g_o) used as an absolute gate resistance; the datasheets give 0.4 Ohm (EPC2014C, EPC2090) and 0.8 Ohm (EPC2057); V_gs_drive is hard-coded 5 V inside compute_total_loss
authors' stacked-switch stress max(N-1, 2) V_in/N exceeds the ladder's 2 V_in/N for N >= 4 (36 vs 24 V at N = 4): conservative (with derating 0.9 the 40-V parts sit exactly at the N = 4 limit)
